items.q: And Eddie Johnson, another friend of mine who was in the trio, a singing trio

ctx.x: And Eddie Johnson, another friend of mine who was in the trio, a singing trio, he used to always kid Merl. He says, 'Well, you've got one great thing going for you. You're the only one in the world that ever fired Charlie Parker.'
